label: Gouache
description: Warm, opaque gouache painting with simple shapes and clear storytelling; suited to family reading.
rendering: A finished gouache painting of the work's world: opaque, matte color laid in confident flat shapes with soft painted edges, like a mid-century illustrated Bible, not a sketch.
palette: Warm, saturated earth colors with deep blues and greens; clear light-and-shade masses.
lighting: Simple, warm, directional light; shadows as flat cool shapes.
materials: Matte opaque paint with visible brush marks and slight dry-brush texture, within the depicted world.
composition: Clear, readable staging with the key figures large; the setting painted out to every edge and corner.
negatives: Paint covers the whole picture, sky and corners included: no paper margins, unpainted edges, border or frame, and no sheet of paper or book page. Avoid cartoon caricature, comic-book styling, photorealism and digital airbrush smoothness.
